# Where to find Enclave Plasma Rifles, Enclave Plasma Pistols, and Mods in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 26, 2023
- 21 min read

Updated: Feb 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_384a08bb23e5412ab88e0321da04858f~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: __Winter The Assaultron__ 

Updated: January 2024

Co-written by Robert Lee - AKA Hippnotic from __Appalachian Hit Squad__. 

With special thanks to the Data Miners: Chraczil, Blobby, and Mapex.

Science, Science Expert, and Science Master Perk Cards under Intelligence will receive an update in September 2023.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4f97b89a291148098bcba71ad8b43a9b~mv2.jpg)

Each rank will grant +5% damage to Energy Weapons, to a max of +30%, and can be stacked with Rifleman, Commando, Gunslinger, and Guerrilla Perk Cards.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bd8886f81813427e9046e2e9686e6b2c~mv2.jpg)

These updated Perk Cards will buff the damage of the following weapons:

- Circuit Breaker 10mm Pistol (Season 15 Scoreboard Reward)
- Alien Blaster
- Alien Disintegrator
- Imposter Assaultron Head
- Salvaged Assaultron Head
- Tesla
- Enclave Plasma Rifles
- Enclave Plasma Pistols
- Plasma Rifles
- Plasma Pistols
- Gamma Gun
- Gauss Pistol
- Gauss Rifle
- Gauss Shotgun
- Mind Over Matter
- Xerxo's Gamma Gun
- Zeta's Revenge
- Acceptable Overkill
- Night Light
- Ultracite Laser
- The V.A.T.S Unknown
- Slug Buster
- Polly's Assaultron Head
- Laser Rifle
- Laser Pistol
- Auto Axe with Electrified Mod - TBC

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b6129df52fa94d47ad652d38acc58f99~mv2.jpg)

 __Where to find Enclave Plasma Rifles and Enclave Plasma Pistols__

Enclave Plasma Rifles and Pistols are often mistaken for Plasma Rifles and Pistols and can not be crafted.

**Transmission Station 1AT-U03**

You will need to have completed the original Enclave questline to be able to enter this location. Hacker and Lock Pick perk cards or Master Infiltrator will help a lot here as well.

From the main lobby, face NE and use either the terminal or lock pick to unlock the white door on the left. Follow the corridor around until you get to a room with a green poisonous cloud. You can either jump into Power Armour, a Chinese Stealth Suit, or just YOLO it through the cloud. Keep following the path around until you get to a room with a Scorched Mothman in it.

Kill the Mothman and then follow the catwalk around on your right. Keep following the platform around until you see a door marked "Exit". Walk through that door and follow the path around until you get to another lab. Drop down to the ground floor, and kill the Wendigo and the other assorted insects.

Face NE and open the white door in front of you. Follow the room around until you get to Lab B with the Scorched Mole Miner in it. Kill the Mole Miner and open the white door on your left. Follow the room around until you get to Lab C. Kill the Deathclaw and take the stairs up to the top and swipe your card.

There is only one way that you can go from here so just follow the rooms and corridors around until you get to the atrium with the Scorched Scientists and Officers. Once you have cleared them, head upstairs and open the white double doors marked "Exit".

There is only one way that you can go from here so keep following the rooms and corridors around until you get to the set of stairs going down into the water. Open the door and follow the rooms and corridors around until you get to the end room where the Scorched Enclave Chief spawns. Again there is only one way that you can go so don't worry about getting lost.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_982e76de3899453d8a75a1334ae4c224~mv2.jpg)

Enclave Plasma Rifles will only drop from the Scorched Enclave Chief.

Note that these rifles are standard and only drop with:

- Standard capacitor
- Short barrel
- Stabilized stock
- Standard sights

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_90b9604e10df466e8188b1315a553d9d~mv2.jpg)

Enclave Plasma Pistols will only drop from the Enclave Officers.

Note that these pistols are standard and only drop with:

- Standard capacitor
- Short barrel
- Standard grip
- Standard sights

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4946ed359f32458d8a136bd7f769b0ca~mv2.jpg)

**Whitespring Bunker**

MODUS - Production Terminals

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2573f9e8d08e472e87ccfd85c4f67181~mv2.jpg)

Fast Travel to The Whitespring Service Entrance and enter the building. Turn South at the end of the hallway and walk over to the large doorway. From the doorway, keep walking straight and jump over the machinery. Enter the large doorway before you and the Production Terminals should be on your left.

4x guaranteed Enclave weapons to spawn:**

- 33.33% chance for an Enclave Pistol Semi Auto
- 33.33% chance for an Enclave Rifle Semi Auto
- 33.33% chance for an Enclave Sniper Rifle Semi Auto
- 50% chance for an Enclave Rifle Auto
- 50% chance for an Enclave Pistol Auto

**Modus is meant to spawn 4 guaranteed Enclave weapons in his inventory but he is currently bugged and will only spawn 2 guaranteed Enclave weapons in his inventory.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1b521006c5fc4bf2866abc7b155593bf~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e407f47d6817468596f785b5a9904780~mv2.jpg)

**Dropped Connection - Enclave Event**

30% Chance to drop an Enclave Plasma Rifle or Enclave Plasma Pistol as an event reward.

The Enclave events "Bots on Parade" and "A Real Blast" **__Do Not__** reward rifles, pistols, or loose yellow box mods. 

__Berkeley Springs__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6ddec2189af34474b75396dd597094ef~mv2.jpg)

__Harper's Ferry__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_584b1a2f5c684887a4695b04f9e0cb23~mv2.jpg)

__Watoga__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2e2c0c0aa9974673a84821262fc210c6~mv2.jpg)

__One of Us__ **- Enclave Questline**

Reconnect MODUS to the Kovac-Muldoon

50% Chance to drop an Enclave Plasma Rifle or Enclave Plasma Pistol as a reward when you open the care package.

All yellow box mods will work for both the Enclave Plasma Rifles and Enclave Plasma Pistols.

__Recommended mods, stats, and rolls__

By Hippnotic

Notes:

- If you have the legendary roll "VATS critical shots do +50% damage" - Use the Calibrated Capacitor mod
- If you have the legendary roll "Faster Fire Rate" - Use the Prime Capacitor mod
- Reflex Sight for any VATS build for better overall stability
- Scope for any non-VATS builds
- Prime your weapon for good overall damage
- Use Anti-Armour for end bosses and tougher enemies
- Use Limit Breaking 4-star mod on your armor for VATS Crit builds

__Flamer__

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- 25% faster fire rate
- 15% faster reload or Breaks 50% slower
- Pyromaniac/Polished
- True Capacitor
- Aligned Flamer Barrel
- Forceful Stock
- Reflex Sight

__Sniper__

VATS Rifleman

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- +50% VATS hit chance OR VATS critical shots do +50% damage
- 25% less VATS Action Point cost
- Conductors OR Polished
- Prime Capacitor OR Any Tuner Mod for 6 extra rounds
- Aligned Sniper Barrel
- Forceful Stock
- Reflex Sight

Long Shot (Non-VATS)

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- Hitman's +25% damage while aiming
- 15% faster reload or Breaks 50% slower
- Stabilizers OR Polished OR Bully's
- Prime Capacitor OR Any Tuner Mod for 6 extra rounds
- Stabilized Sniper Barrel
- Forceful Stock
- Reflex Sight or Short/Medium/Long Scope (personal preference)

__Splitter__

VATS Rifleman

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- +50% VATS hit chance OR VATS critical shots do +50% damage
- 25% less VATS Action Point cost
- Conductors OR Polished
- Prime Capacitor
- Aligned Splitter Barrel
- Forceful Stock
- Reflex Sight

Shotgunner (does not use Shotgun Perk Cards)

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- 25% faster fire rate
- 15% faster reload or Breaks 50% slower
- Polished OR Bully's
- Prime Capacitor
- True Splitter Barrel
- Stabilized Stock
- Reflex Sight

__Automatic__

VATS Commando

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- 25% faster fire rate or VATS critical shots do +50% damage
- 25% less VATS Action Point cost
- Conductors Or Polished
- Prime Capacitor or Calibrated Capacitor (for more VATS critical damage)
- Aligned Automatic Barrel
- Stabilized Stock
- Reflex Sight

Aim Down Sights (ADS)

- Bloodied or Anti-Armour
- 25% faster fire rate
- 15% faster reload or Breaks 50% slower
- Polished OR Bully's
- Prime Capacitor
- Stabilized Automatic Barrel
- Stabilized stock
- Reflex sight or Scope of choice (personal preference)
